name: 32996-prefillheavy-qwen38bfp8-1gpu
hardware: 1x H100 80GB HBM3 (one GPU of an a3 node, --gres=gpu:1).
parallelism: TP=1, PP=1, DP=1. One in-process vLLM engine on one GPU; no router, no external cache tier, no KV connector.
architecture: dense decoder (Qwen3ForCausalLM), 36 layers, hidden 4096, intermediate 12288, 32 query / 8 KV heads, head_dim 128, 40960-token window, vocab 151936; ships natively FP8, ~9.5 GB of weights.
load_profile: concurrent (closed loop), streams=16, warmup 25%, cooldown 10%, bounded at 256 requests with a 900 s safety cap, static seed 32996.
workload: synthetic `synthetic_text`, single turn, no prefix bucket: 4096 prompt tokens in (min = max) and exactly 128 tokens out (min = max) per request, so every request is the same size. 256 requests is 1,048,576 prompt tokens and 32,768 generated, warmup included. The checkpoint's chat template is applied, so the engine's own prompt count reads about a dozen tokens above 4096.
purpose: A document analysis assistant summarizing long reports for sixteen concurrent users on a single GPU.
launch:
model: Qwen/Qwen3-8B-FP8
tensor-parallel-size: 1

# Prefix caching is ON by default on this engine, so this line IS an override.
enable-prefix-caching: false

max-model-len: 8192
max-num-batched-tokens: 8192
max-num-seqs: 256
